title: pipelines → studio's projector: one step of an assistant turn
description: From API 1.44 (plan 18, 22.3). Subject `evt.assistant.<thread_id>.step` (stream EVT, durable `studio-assistant`), Nats-Msg-Id `<thread_id>:<seq>`. Published when the graph parks (`wait`: actions or cards pending) and when the turn ends (`done`). Studio stores the text, lines and cards in the chat's rows, sets the thread's state and appends a `step` event to the chat's stream (GET …/events); the drawer of `client_id` runs `actions` in order and posts their results. A republish (same seq) replaces, never duplicates.

text.description: the assistant's words in this step, shown as text, never HTML; from API 1.63 with checked ```options blocks and [[kind:<id>]] refs (contracts/README.md, Assistant: pick one and refs)

lines.description: lines of the server's calls (Looked at, Searched the web, Remembered)

actions.description: pending: the screen actions to run, in order

error.description: why the turn ended early (done is then true)

summary_id.description: a summarize input: the summary item written
